title: Prompt box: the @ picker names every reference on multi-picture edit models
description: Qwen-Image 2.1, FLUX.3, Klein, Krea2, Qwen Edit and the cloud edit models take several pictures, but their edit/control slots carry no tag, so the @ picker never arms and the chips show only a position. Give those slots numbered tags and make each model write the wording its encoder reads; add the check to the add-model playbook.
